title: Model Compatibility & Enterprise Fit Matrix for Regulated Workloads
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: Build a reproducible, prioritized matrix that maps public and partner model variants to common regulated enterprise workloads (finance, healthcare, legal, gov). The matrix should capture compatibility criteria (data residency, on-prem support, determinism, hallucination profile, privacy guarantees, quantized performance characteristics), business signals (unit cost at 512/2048 tokens, latency percentiles, SLA readiness), and go-to-market implications (recommended product bundles, required contractual clauses, and sales enablement artifacts). This ticket covers research, competitive analysis, customer interviews, and the delivery of a single canonical CSV + presentation for exec and GTM teams.
context: As Redwood expands Private and Dedicated customer traction, enterprise buyers increasingly evaluate model provenance, reproducibility, and regulatory fit rather than raw capability alone. We need a single source of truth that product, sales, and solutions engineering can use when advising customers and shaping Dedicated/Private packaging. Existing model landscape docs focus on capability buckets; this work explicitly ties technical signals to contractual and operational requirements for regulated workloads.
objectives: Produce an enterprise-fit matrix covering >=15 model variants across 4 regulated verticals
Identify top 5 model-compatibility risks (e.g., hallucination in legal reasoning, inability to meet data residency) and mitigation patterns
Deliver GTM recommendations for three packaging configurations (hosted with compliance add-on, Dedicated with customer KMS, Private on-prem stub)
success_metrics: Matrix accepted by Product + Solutions Engineering (approval recorded)
At least 2 active sales opportunities reference the matrix in proposal within 6 weeks
Reduction in pre-sales discovery time for compliance questions by 30% (self-reported by SEs)
deliverables: short playbook (one-pager) for sales/solutions with recommended packaging and contract hooks
tasks: Kickoff alignment: invite PM, SE leads, Privacy/Legal, Research (1 hour)
Competitive mapping: inventory 15 model variants (open + partner) and capture public spec + verified metrics
Technical evaluations: run 3 focused evals (privacy tests, hallucination prompts, latency at 512/2048 tokens) on internal infra
Customer interviews: 5 enterprise customers across finance/healthcare/legal to validate decision criteria
Cost modeling: compute unit-cost estimates for hosted/dedicated/private for 3 workload profiles
Assemble CSV and annotate fields with data sources and confidence score
Draft GTM playbook and circulate for review with Sales and Legal
Present to Leadership and iterate based on feedback
